title: Ancient Peru
short_description: Discover Lima, Paracas, Cusco, the Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Humantay, Q’eswachaka, Rainbow Mountain and Lake Titicaca in 12 days.
long_description: Discover deep Peru on a 12-day, 11-night journey through the coast, Andean culture and the country's greatest historic treasures.
price_note: From USD 739 per person. Subject to availability.
seo_title: Ancient Peru 12 Days / 11 Nights | Machu Picchu and Titicaca
seo_description: Visit Machu Picchu, Q’eswachaka, Rainbow Mountain and Lake Titicaca.
seo_keywords: ancient peru, 12 day peru package, machu picchu, titicaca, qeswachaka

days.title: Day 2: Paracas – Ica – Huacachina
days.text: Ballestas Islands, wine tasting, lunch, dune buggies and sandboarding.

days.title: Day 4: Cusco City Tour
days.text: Cathedral, Qorikancha, Sacsayhuaman, Qenqo, Puka Pukara and Tambomachay.

days.title: Day 5: Sacred Valley
days.text: Chinchero, Moray, Maras, Urubamba and Ollantaytambo.

days.title: Day 6: Machu Picchu
days.text: Train, bus and guided visit. Return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 7: Humantay Lake
days.text: Breakfast, hike, guided visit and lunch.

days.title: Day 8: Q’eswachaka Inca Bridge
days.text: Visit the last living Inca bridge and Apurimac viewpoints.

days.title: Day 10: Route of the Sun – Puno
days.text: Andahuaylillas, Raqchi, La Raya and Pukara.

days.title: Day 11: Uros – Sillustani
days.text: Floating islands, Sillustani and Umayo Lagoon.

includes: Transfers in Lima, Cusco and Puno
